ratingScale.1: Very Low - Little to no capability
ratingScale.5: Very High - Fully capable and ready

questions.text: Is there a clear need to query domain-specific knowledge bases or proprietary data that public LLMs don't know?
Does the use case require explainable, source-cited AI outputs (e.g., 'Answer based on Policy Doc v2.3')?
Is real-time or frequently updated information retrieval critical to the use case?
Does the use case require synthesising insights across multiple documents or sources simultaneously?
Is there a governance or data security requirement controlling which users can access which knowledge?
Is the primary use case a natural fit for RAG (e.g., internal Q&A, support bot, policy assistant, contract review)?
Is there a clear need for autonomous task execution — AI taking action without constant human approval?
Does the use case involve integration with multiple tools, APIs, or enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, ITSM, etc.)?
Does the prospect have well-defined success criteria and measurable outcomes for agent-driven tasks?
Does the prospect have a risk management or human-in-the-loop framework for oversight of agent actions?
Does the prospect face regulatory or compliance constraints that require full auditability of automated actions?
Is leadership committed to piloting and iterating on agentic AI, with budget for experimentation?
Does the prospect have high-volume natural language generation needs (e.g., content creation, email drafting, report generation)?
Is there a requirement for customer-facing conversational interfaces (chatbot, virtual assistant, self-service)?
Does the prospect require fine-tuning or domain adaptation of an LLM on proprietary datasets?
Are the latency and throughput requirements of the use case compatible with LLM API response times?
Is there a need for consistent brand voice, tone, and output control across AI-generated content?
Does the prospect have a content safety, moderation, and responsible AI policy in place?
Does senior leadership have a clear, articulated AI vision with active executive sponsorship for the initiative?
Is there a well-defined business use case with specific, measurable outcomes tied to the AI project?
Is the prospect's data infrastructure (pipelines, storage, APIs) mature enough to support AI integration and deployment?
Does the prospect have a defined framework for AI ethics, bias monitoring, and regulatory compliance?
Does the prospect have realistic timeline expectations and adequate budget allocated for the AI initiative?
Is there a pilot/POC mindset — willingness to start small, measure, and iterate before full-scale rollout?
